purpose: Original in-game arena and boss sprites for Astella 2D

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original production game environment art for ASTELLA, a 2D pixel-art fantasy boss-raid game. Create ONE full-screen 16:9 landscape arena BACKGROUND with NO CHARACTERS and NO UI. The camera is a fixed orthographic 50-degree quarter-view game camera: the vertical walls and columns have short visible faces but the central walkable floor is viewed from above, no horizon and no sky.

Scene: the ancient silver-amethyst Sanctuary of Resonance, in a quiet blue-violet crystal forest. A large broad OVAL SILVER-STONE COMBAT PLATFORM fills the central 70 percent of the canvas, with its long axis horizontal. The entire central play area is unobstructed flat pale desaturated blue-gray stone, delicate cracks and subtle square/diamond floor motifs, a small faint engraved star at the very center. Plenty of clean space for combat and red telegraph shapes to be drawn by the game. No giant landmark in the middle. Around only the OUTER MARGINS are violet crystalline ferns, small blue glowing flowers, dark ruined stone columns, low silver railings and faceted amethyst clusters. A broken arch and crystal grove frame the top border, with stairs facing down at the lower center. Floor and scenery should remain naturally readable as a walkable 2D arena.

Art: beautiful restrained hand-crafted pixel art like a polished modern 2D action RPG, crisp square pixel clusters, compact color palette, no vector curves, no photorealism, no painterly smooth shading, no depth of field, no blurred glow. Pixel scale should suit 128x144 eight-direction chibi fantasy character sprites. Colors: deep ink-purple forest margins, cool slate floor, pale silver accents, restrained bright amethyst crystals and icy blue flowers. The floor has moderate lightness and low contrast so tiny characters stand out. Atmospheric and inviting, clear gameplay readability. Symmetric balanced gameplay space but interesting asymmetric crystal borders. No text, letters, words, logo, HUD, buttons, health bars, cursors, grid overlays, people, monsters, weapons, watermarks or frame. This is only the environment layer; all characters and UI will be rendered live by Unity.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original 2D pixel-art fantasy raid boss SPRITE for ASTELLA, isolated with a genuine transparent alpha background, no scenery. The creature is a silver-and-amethyst CRYSTAL WARDEN: a broad imposing ancient stone automaton knight, faceted violet crystal heart inside its chest, engraved silver stone armor, asymmetric crystal pauldrons, short heavy arms and feet, modest jagged crystal crown. A distinctive stout silhouette and clear crystal core, readable at only 160 pixels tall. Its pose is idle combat readiness, facing SOUTH toward the viewer in a fixed 50-degree orthographic quarter-view, the same view as 128x144 eight-direction chibi RPG pixel sprites. Show the complete body and feet. Do NOT depict a realistic human or elaborate high-detail illustration.

Beautiful polished pixel-art sprite with clearly visible square pixel clusters, stepped outlines, hard limited-palette shading, no soft airbrush or gradients. Around 96x112 pixels of intentional silhouette detail visually upscaled crisply; do not bake any pixel-grid background. Deep ink-purple outlines, cool slate and polished silver, luminous amethyst core, restrained ice blue accents. Armor highlights should be clean and tasteful. No weapons extending far outside the compact character bounds, no giant wings, no fire, no dramatic action, no floor, no backdrop, no cast shadow ellipse (the engine supplies one), no letters, no UI, no text, no logo, no watermark. One whole single sprite centered in a compact square transparent canvas with a small safety margin; no sprite sheet or multiple poses.
